subject: Discrete Mathematics: Set Theory & Algebra
name: Relations
priorityEvidence: 38 PYQs extracted — highest-PYQ topic in this subject, tested from 1987 to 2026 almost continuously. Scheduled right after Set Theory because a relation is formally a subset of a Cartesian product (needs set notation).

prerequisites.why: A relation R on A is a subset of A×A — needs set/subset comfort.

unlocks.why: A function is a relation with extra restrictions (each input maps to exactly one output).
Partial order = reflexive + antisymmetric + transitive relation — direct extension of property-checking.
Lattices are built on partial-order relations.
Functional dependencies are themselves a kind of relation over attribute sets; closure computation reuses the same reasoning style as transitive closure here.
